system.description:
“There has to be a way out!” the bandit screamed as he raced down the same hallway for the 20th time. “How did we end up here!? This was supposed to be an easy job.” The bandit screams as his voice echo’s infinitely. Elsewhere a young girl wearing a chunin vest sits in a tree eating ice cream as she watches the bandit run in circles screaming pointlessly. She giggles to herself before finishing her snack. She reaches into her side pouch drawing a single kunai and approaches them “I guess, I had my fun. Time to put an end to this.”

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 3 excerpt.

Illusions as Real as Reality

The Kurama Clan is a clan of extremely skilled Genjutsu users. This talent in Genjutsu is due to the Kekkei Genkai that the clan possesses. However, once every few generations, a member of the clan will be born with such enormous skill in Genjutsu that their illusions causes the brain to make anything that happens to the victim within the Genjutsu physically real, allowing the clan member to potentially kill their opponents with Genjutsu.

Kurama Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Wis or Cha, +1 Int

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Illusions, Insight

Illusory Genius: You reduce downtime cost to learn Genjutsu you qualify for by an amount equal to their rank, to a minimum of 1. (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5)

Deep Sleep: Over the course of a long rest, your dreams are made manifest. Select one skill or Toolkit and gain proficiency in it until your next long rest. If you have proficiency already, you instead gain a rank of Mastery with that skill

Photographic Memory: You retain information, images and words better than anyone. Your mind is a lockbox. You can perfectly recall anything you’ve read, seen or heard within the last 3 months, without making a check.

Kurama Features

Onijutsu

1st Level Clan Feature

Your Genjutsu are extensions of your subconsciousness, and your ability to control your dreams using your clans Kekkei Genkai give birth to a unique subset of Genjutsu molding, known as Onijutsu. The Kurama clans Onijutsu manifests in the form of Oni-Coils. You have a number of coils equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus.

You can spend Oni-Coils on chosen Onijutsu. Each Onijutsu costs 1 or more Oni-Coils. If an Onijutsu costs more than 1 Oni-Coil it will specify its cost, otherwise, they cost 1 Oni-Coil. Each Onijutsu can be used once per turn, as part of casting a Genjutsu you know, unless otherwise specified. You can use up to 2 Onijutsu per casting. You regain spent Oni-Coils when you finish a rest. You gain 2 Onijutsu at character creation and can select one additional Onijutsu at 7th and 15th levels.

Infectious Genjutsu

When an affected creature, fails their saving throw or you score a hit with your Genjutsu attack, the target becomes a relay point for your Genjutsu. Until the beginning of your next turn, Once per turn, if the affected creature has an ally move within 10 feet of them, the moving creature must make a Saving throw against the effects of your Genjutsu, suffering its effects as if they were the original target.

Overwhelming Illusions

When a creature succeeds their saving throw against the amplified Genjutsu, until the end of their next turn, they increase the cost of jutsu they cast by an amount equal to the rank of the amplified jutsu. (D-Rank: +4, C-Rank: +8, B-Rank: +12, A-Rank: +16, S-Rank: +20)

Punishing Illusions

If one of your targets succeeds on their save against the amplified Genjutsu, you manifest a secondary illusion with the original. The affected creature remakes their saving throw.

If they fail this remade save, they suffer the Genjutsu’s effects of a Success, but also become Confused.

Sensory Domination

A creature that fails their saving throw against the amplified Genjutsu, that have a special sense such as Blind Sight or Chakra Sight are instead Blinded for the duration of the jutsu. If the jutsu doesn’t have a duration, they remain blinded until the beginning of your next turn.

Subtle Illusion

The amplified Genjutsu can be cast without Hand Signs (HS) or Chakra Seals (CS). When cast this way, you must either make eye contact or make physical contact with the target as part of the jutsu’s casting.

The Pain Is Real

At the cost of 2 Oni-Coils, when you cast a Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu that deals damage as an Action, you can convert it into a Genjutsu. The Jutsu cast loses its Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu keywords, gaining the Genjutsu and Tactile keywords.

Will Breaker

When an affected creature fails their saving throw against the amplified Genjutsu, their bodies ability to resist harm suffers as well. They suffer a -1 penalty to their next Strength or Dexterity saving throw. This increases to -2 at 11th level.

Versatile Authority

A creature making a saving throw against the amplified Genjutsu that has ranks of a Physical or Elemental condition cannot gain a jutsu based bonus to their saving throw.

Dream Walker

Dream Walker

Medium Illusory Construct

Armor Class 13 + your proficiency bonus

Hit Points 11 + Proficiency Bonus + your level.

Speed 30 ft.

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | +0 | + | CON | +0 | + | WIS | +0 | + |

| DEX | +0 | + | INT | +0 | + | CHA | +0 | + |

Save Proficiencies All

Dream Walker Type

Dream Beast. +3 Str, Con. +2 Dex, Wis. Resistant to Acid, Bludgeoning and Earth damage. +20ft speed.

Dream Demon. +3 Str, Cha. +2 Con, Int. Resistant to Fire, Necrotic and Slashing damage. +20ft speed.

Dream Dragon. +3 Int, Con. +2 Dex, Cha. Resistant to Force, Lightning and Wind damage. 30ft Fly speed.

Dream Fey. +3 Wis, Con. +2 Dex, Cha. Resistant to Cold, Poison and Psychic damage. 30ft Fly speed.

Dream Spider. +3 Dex, Wis. +2 Str, Con. Resistant to Physical and Elemental Conditions. 60ft climb speed

Dream Walker Traits

Strong Dreams. Increase all modifiers by +1 at 7th level and again at 15th level.

Illusory Construct. This creature cannot physically interact with the environment and cannot be more than 60 feet away from their summoner before being dispelled. It can move through the spaces of other creatures as if they were difficult terrain. It reduces its hit points by 5 if it ends its turn inside an object where its summoner cannot see it. If an effect it uses requires a saving throw, it uses either your Ninjutsu or Genjutsu save DC.

Attacks

Strike (Melee). Melee Genjutsu Attack: 5ft., one target. Highest Mod + Prof to hit, 1d8 + Mod psychic damage. This increases to 2d8 at 11th

Strike (Ranged). Ranged Genjutsu Attack: 30ft., one target. Highest Mod + Prof to hit, 1d6 + Mod psychic damage. This increases to 2d6 at 11th

Abilities

Beast Pounce. One creature within15 feet must make an Intelligence Saving throw, being knocked prone and Dazed on a failed save.

Demons Bargain. Once creature within 20 feet must make a Wisdom Saving throw, going Berserk on a failed save. Once this ability is used it cannot be used again until the end of your next turn.

Dragons Breath. All creatures in a 30-foot cone must make a Charisma saving throw, being Weakened on a failed save.

Fey Trickery. One creature within 60 feet must make an Intelligence saving throw, being Dazzled on a failed save.

Spiders Web. All creatures within a 10-foot cube, centering on a point you can see within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw, being Concussed on a failed save.

1st Level Clan Feature

Whenever you awake from a rest, you bring something from your dreams with you, a Dream Walker. A Dream Walker is an illusory construct given life and form by your subconscious. You choose the type of Dream Walker from the following list: Dream Fey, Dream Beast, Dream Dragon, Dream Spider, Dream Demon.

Use the Dream Walker stat block found as part of this clan, and apply the specific Dream types traits. Your Dream Walker grows in strength alongside you, and can affect the waking world so long as you can prevent it from falling to 0 hit points. When it does, its dispelled, until you complete your next rest. Your Dream Walker regains all missing hit points when you complete a rest.

Alternatively, when you cast a Jutsu or use a feature that summons a chakra construct, or when you complete your rest while you have a jutsu on your known list that summons a chakra construct, you can spend 2 Oni-Coils to use that creatures stat block as your Dream Walker.

Your Dream Walker only obeys you and doesn’t acknowledge the existence of anyone else unless you command it to. It only obeys your commands. In combat, it acts on your turn. You can command your Dream Walker to do the following:

Move. At no action cost to you, you can command your Dream Walker to move its full movement.

Strike. As part of an attack made with your Attack action or a Jutsu you cast that makes attacks, you can forgo any number of attacks to command your Dream Walker to use its Strike attack.

Distort. As a bonus action, you can command your Dream Walker to use its associated ability. If an ability calls for a saving throw, you use either your Ninjutsu or Genjutsu jutsu save DC.

Pass Through. Starting at 7th level, as part of casting a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu you know, you can have your jutsu originate from your Dream Walker.

Inflict Harm. Starting at 7th level, as part of casting a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu you know, you can have your Dream Walker perform the attacks and use their Strikes in place of [Unarmed] or [Weapon Damage].

Illusion Made Manifest

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your dreams give weight and form to the thoughts and ideals you wish to make real. When you complete a rest, you can select one weapon group and gain proficiency in those weapons. When you wield a weapon from that group, it takes on an ethereal, almost ghost like form.

Only you can wield this weapon and its damage type becomes Psychic. While wielding the weapon, you can choose to spend Oni-Coils to utilize one of the following abilities. If the affected creature is already making a save throw as a result of damage or to reduce damage, then on a failed save apply these abilities effects:

Memory Haze. As part of dealing [Weapon Damage] you can spend 1 Oni-Coil to force the affected creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the affected creature becomes Confused as their more pressing thoughts become fleeting memories.

Stolen Thoughts. As part of dealing [Weapon Damage], you can spend 2 Oni-Coils to force the affected creature to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, you become aware of their most immediate goals, and they forget them for the next minute.

Déjà vu

| #### Well Rested / Will Amp / You ever slept so well; it boosted your capabilities? Well now you have. / Fresh Start. You gain temporary chakra points equal to your level. These temporary chakra points last until used or your next rest. / Quick Start. The next initiative roll you make is at advantage. / Loose Shoulders. The first instance of damage you deal is increased by +1 damage die. If multiple damage die of different sizes are rolled, add one additional die of the largest size. / Quick Reaction. The first reaction you take in combat does not consume your reaction for the round. You can use this effect once per application of this status. / No longer Rested. Once all of these benefits have been consumed or used, this status ends. |

3rd Level Clan Feature

Some people say dreams are like prophecy, able to foretell an event before it happens. Yours are no different.

When you would need to make a contested check against an opponent’s Charisma or Wisdom based skill, you can make your check at advantage, because you’ve already seen this transpire in a dream you’ve had. Once you use this, you cannot do so again for 10 minutes, as dreams are often difficult to decipher or recall on demand.

Deep Sleep

7th Level Clan Feature

Your allies have never had a deep sleep like you, and thus, they have never been as well rested as you either. When you and your allies would complete a Long Rest together, you all become Well Rested.

Lucid Dreams

7th Level Clan Feature

When you summon your Dream Walker its form is more malleable. More surreal. You are able to adjust its form and tweak it to better fit what you originally dreamed it was. Select one of the following Lucid Dream modifications and apply it to your Dream Walker. You can change this modification when you complete a rest of any type.

Elemental

You dream that your Dream Walker was more of an elemental instead of a mythical creature. Their form changes and exhibits some qualities of a single nature release you have access to. If you do not have access to a nature release, you instead roll 1d6 and that is the nature release it is most like for the duration (1: Earth, 2: Wind, 3: Fire, 4: Water, 5: Lightning, 6: Reroll).

Depending on the nature release it embodies, select two jutsu you know of C-Rank or lower with the associated nature release keyword. Those become abilities it can use twice per initiative, each. If you do not have 2 jutsu with the associated keyword, or you had to randomly select via the dice, they instead gain the chosen jutsu based on their nature release association.

Earth Release. Agonizing Thorn (D-Rank), Tectonic Palm (C-Rank)

Wind Release. Slicing Wind Bullet (D-Rank), Great Breakthrough (C-Rank)

Fire Release. Phoenix Fire (D-Rank), Flame Armor (C-Rank)

Water Release. Tsunami Mallet (D-Rank), Hiding In Mist (C-Rank)

Lightning Release. Guiding Bolt (D-Rank), Lightning Rope

Warrior

You dream that your Dream Walker was more of a warrior instead of a mythical creature. Their form changes and exhibits some qualities of a warrior, samurai or even a shinobi. Select two Taijutsu or Bukijutsu you know of C-Rank or lower. Those become abilities it can use twice per initiative, each. If you do not have a combination of two Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, your Dream Walker instead gains one of the following based on their type of your choice.

Brute. Leaf Uppercut (D-Rank), Beast (C-Rank)

Samurai. Yosaku Cut (D-Rank), Disarming Riposte (C-Rank)

Ninja. Crippling Strike(D-Rank), Mikiri Counter (C-Rank)

Vegetative

You dream that your Dream Walker was more of an primal extract of nature instead of a mythical creature. Their form changes and exhibits some qualities of plants or fungi that exude substances used in Medicine. If you have access to Medical Release, you select the type of vegetable. If you do not have access to Medical Release, you instead roll 1d4 and that is the creature/damage type it is most like for the duration (1: Flowers (Poison), 2: Fungi (Necrotic), 3: Moss (Acid), 4: Reroll).

Depending on the plant type it embodies, select two jutsu you know of C-Rank or lower with the associated damage or effects most similar. Those become abilities it can use twice per initiative, each. If you do not have 2 jutsu with the associated damage or effects, or you had to randomly select via the dice, they instead gain the chosen jutsu based on their plant type association.

Flowers. Poisonous Blast (D-Rank), Poison Mist (C-Rank)

Fungi. Necrosis (D-Rank), Vampiric Touch (C-Rank)

Moss. Acid String (D-Rank), Acidic Bolt (C-Rank)

Mental Resistance

11th Level Clan Feature

Your mind and will is shielded by your subconscious. You gain a rank of mastery to Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws.

Inner Self

15th Level Clan Feature

Your subconscious rises to the surface, becoming your true self. You’ve been training this piece of you unknowingly, until now. Your Dream Walker. As a bonus action, while you have a Dream Walker active, you fuse into them, assuming their form, and using their stat blocks ability scores, attacks, abilities and hit points. You retain your own weapon and skill proficiencies and jutsu knowledge, plus any it has that you don’t know. For the next minute, you retain this state. If your hit points fall to 0, you revert back to your normal form and your Dream Walker is dispelled. Once you transform in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest. Alternatively, you can spend 2 Oni-Coils to transform back into your Dream Walker form early.
